title: Demographic and Settlement Impacts of the Full-Scale Russian Invasion of Ukraine Across All 123 Oblast, Occupation-History, and Federal-Subject Divisions of Ukraine (33 across 27 Oblasts), Belarus (7), and the Russian Federation (83) (2021AD - 2026AD)
